answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using flow-bounded trust graphs. Anchors issue capped cryptographic vouches so paths branch like a willow rather than letting fake accounts spread like a vine across the network. Verifiers evaluate each registration thread via max-flow capacity from anchors, forcing attackers to incur the verifiable cost of obtaining scarce legitimate endorsements per identity. However, colluding insiders who sell vouch capacity can still admit fake clusters.
